**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Clause:** § 2.2 (the first of the two clauses numbered 2.2) — "Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term."
- **Why it fails:** Full-term exclusive dealing binding us, with no performance-based exit. That is walk-away territory and it does not reach the fallback (defined category, 12-month cap, automatic end on service-level/delivery failure).
- **Internal conflict noted:** § 2.1 disclaims any purchase commitment and § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledging we made *no* exclusivity commitment, so § 2.2 is inconsistent with the rest of the bargain.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** delete § 2.2, with a comment offering the narrowed 12-month/category-limited fallback if Vendor needs volume protection.
- Other "exclusive" references (§ 13.1 licence grant, § 19.4/§ 21.4/§ 30.2 remedies, § 28.2 jurisdiction) are unrelated and were not flagged.
